title: Use a social data card to carry one chart’s finding into a feed in two crops.
rule: Draw the card at true size for each crop, 1080 by 1350 and 1080 by 1080, with the evidence word, the chart’s own title, the chart redrawn at card scale with its inks, key and named marks, and a short source line that says where every value is. Set every word at 36 px or more at true size, since a feed shows the card at about a third of its size, and the title larger. Where the chart’s labels cannot fit, name only the marks the title names and say what each mark stands for. Post the card with its alt text and the finding in a sentence or two, and keep the full table with the chart.
use_when: A finding from a core chart goes to Substack, email or a social feed as a still image.

use_instead.when: The reader needs every value, or the post links to the full chart
One figure carries the finding alone

text: A feed shows a card at about a third of its size, so only large type and a few labels read there. Keeping the chart’s own title, inks and named marks makes the card the same finding as the chart, and the source line sends a reader to every value.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form social-data-card around the form encode.of names: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s95; card.crops sets the crops, card.post the words to post, labels.card_source the card’s source line and labels.card_inner what the inner form reads (dot-plot: label named, ranks across).
